entries.value: The war moves — a front shifts, a clock ticks, territory changes hands
A faction advances — a present faction pushes its agenda a step
A faction turns on another — two powers collide (roll which)
A new power emerges — generate a faction (ref 04); a vacuum just filled
Threat closes in — a hostile force, hunt, or ambush arrives (encounter table)
Monster surge — feral or sapient; the swarm presses (monster tables)
Crosser contact — a bloc element appears or makes contact (crosser tables)
The empowered — a new power manifests, or a free agent acts (empowered tables)
Scarcity bites — something runs out, breaks, or is taken (scarcity table)
An ally / NPC acts — a known figure moves toward their goal
An NPC's truth surfaces — a secret, lie, or real loyalty is exposed
A thread advances — an open thread lurches forward
A thread is blocked — an open thread reverses, stalls, or is closed against you
Refugees / civilians — the human tide: need, panic, opportunity, witness
The dark world — environment/hazard: grid, weather, structure, terrain fails
Authority acts — police, Guard, redoubt, or local power asserts itself
Word arrives — rumor, news, a message, a runner (rumor table)
A turn against you — betrayal, defection, a price comes due
The PC's world — something tied to the PC's people, past, or ties intrudes
The horizon — a glimpse of the Unmaking, the Empire, or the deep future
